headline: BAJAJFINSV met its guidance for consolidated revenue growth but saw mixed performance in BAGIC and BALIC segments with some metrics moving towards stabilization as per management's statements.

segments.BAGIC: BAGIC's gross written premium (GWP) growth was predominantly down due to a large order spill over, while the combined ratio continued to be good despite NATCAT claims. Profit after tax increased by 39% and ROE stood at 14%.
segments.BALIC: BALIC saw muted new business value growth but recorded a significant increase in profit after tax of 106%, aided by a tax reversal, reflecting efforts to adjust the product mix.

keyThemes: Stabilization of GWP growth metrics moving towards improvement
Solvency ratios remain strong at over 300%
Focus on profitability and quality insurance book in BAGIC
Strategic changes in product mix for BALIC to improve profitability
